headline: Man United head coach Michael Carrick leaves Carrington amid doubts over his future
description: Under-fire head coach Michael Carrick has arrived at Carrington after Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox held talks over his future.

headline: Virgil van Dijk: No one can replicate Mohamed Salah but new-look Liverpool attack has to step up
description: Liverpool's revamped forward line has done well enough to ensure Mohamed Salah's name has never been mentioned at Anfield this season but captain Virgil van Dijk knows the next generation still have work to do.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United eye Branthwaite amid defensive rebuild
description: Manchester United are plotting a huge defensive rebuild, with Everton center back Jarrad Branthwaite at the center of their plans. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man United are in crisis (again), but where are the Glazers?
description: Manchester United are in crisis -- again -- and the people with ultimate control of one of the world's most historic soccer clubs are nowhere to be seen.

headline: A global experiment: Can ESPN predict the Ballon d'Or awards?
description: The Ballon d'Or awards are typically tough to predict, but can ESPN and our global resources do just that?

headline: Real Madrid best Barça in brilliant Clásico; Man United mess deepens; Spurs win again
description: The weekend's big games brought plenty to unpack, with Real Madrid's Clásico win slowing Barcelona down in LaLiga and Man United's heavy home defeat surely pushing Michael Carrick toward the exit.
